h1: Photo Booth Hire Croydon for Weddings, Proms and Parties
intro: From a banqueting suite near the town centre to a church hall in Selsdon, photo booth hire in Croydon should be easy to arrange, and Boothdrop Entertainment keeps it that way. Our attendant arrives with the booth, the props and a print template designed around your event, and packages from £239 include delivery, setup, pack-down and unlimited sessions.

sections.heading: From East Croydon to Sanderstead: our Croydon patch
paragraphs: We cover the whole London Borough of Croydon, not only the streets around the town centre. That takes in Thornton Heath, Norbury and South Norwood in the north, Addiscombe and Shirley to the east, Selsdon and Sanderstead to the south-east, and Purley and Coulsdon down towards the Surrey boundary. The borough is part of our regular South London work, and we are just as comfortable heading over the border into Surrey or across to neighbouring Bromley.

Because the borough runs from busy inner-London streets to the green southern edge of the capital, the events vary just as widely. A family party in Thornton Heath and a golf club reception near Coulsdon call for different kit, different access plans and sometimes a different booth, so we plan each booking on its own terms rather than sending the same set-up everywhere.

sections.heading: Hotels, banqueting suites and halls across the borough
paragraphs: Croydon has a broad spread of event spaces. Around the town centre there are hotels and conference venues with function suites, lifts and service entrances, which suit weddings and corporate evenings. Banqueting suites host many of the borough's larger family celebrations, with stages, dance floors and plenty of room for a showpiece booth, while golf clubs on the southern side offer a calmer setting for receptions and anniversary dinners.

Then come the community halls, church halls and school halls that host christenings, children's parties, fundraisers and prom nights. These rooms are often plain and brightly lit, so a booth with its own LED lighting and a background that can be swapped digitally makes a real difference to the finished photos. Tell us the venue type and roughly how big the room is, and we will suggest the booth that fits it best.

sections.heading: Getting in: roads, parking and the loading door
paragraphs: Our team usually reaches Croydon along the A23, which links to the M23 and junction 7 of the M25 for venues on the Surrey side, with the A232 and A212 carrying us across the borough to Addiscombe, Shirley and Selsdon. Traffic around the town centre builds in the late afternoon, so we leave generous margins and arrive well ahead of your start time. Hotels and banqueting suites typically have a car park or service yard; halls on residential streets mean unloading at the door and parking close by.

Your guests may arrive by train at East Croydon or on the tram network, but our kit always travels by van, and ULEZ charges are covered by us rather than added to your bill. Each booth needs one standard socket, or two for the Inflatable Booth, and setup takes 45 to 60 minutes before the hire begins at no extra cost. Stairs are fine for the slimmer pods; the Magic Mirror, Party Booth and Inflatable Booth need a lift or a ground-floor room.

sections.heading: Matching the booth to a Croydon celebration
paragraphs: The LCD SlimPod is where most Croydon hosts start. It is our most affordable booth, needs just 1.5m by 2m of floor and one plug, and its smart background removal turns a plain hall wall into any scene you like, with GIFs and boomerangs alongside the prints. For couples, the Magic Mirror is the wedding photo booth Croydon receptions tend to favour: a full-length interactive mirror with animations, a DSLR camera and a print for every guest in the shot.

Magic mirror hire Croydon-wide comes with the same attendant, props and guest book as every other booking; the mirror simply needs a 2m by 2m space and level access or a lift. The Party Booth is the party photo booth Croydon prom committees and 18th birthday hosts usually pick, thanks to its curtain and room for eight inside, while the GIF Booth suits office launches and staff socials, sending animated clips by email or QR code within seconds.
list: LCD SlimPod: church halls, school halls and christenings
Magic Mirror: hotel and banqueting suite weddings
GIF Booth: corporate events near the town centre

sections.heading: Planning advice for Croydon families and organisers
paragraphs: Croydon's celebrations reflect the many communities who call the borough home. South Asian weddings with mehndi nights and grand receptions, Caribbean and African weddings with long evenings of music and dancing, christenings and naming ceremonies, and milestone birthdays from a first to a 60th all come our way. For a wedding spread over several days, tell us about each event separately: a slim pod at a henna night and a Magic Mirror at the reception is a popular pairing, and the print template can carry different wording for each occasion.

Big receptions often run late, so agree the booth's hours with the venue's finish time and leave space for pack-down. Proms for the borough's schools cluster in late June and early July, while Christmas parties for offices around the town centre fill December weekends quickly. An £80 deposit secures the date, with the balance due one month before the event, so booking early costs very little and removes the worry.

Check the venue's curfew before agreeing the hire window
Send logos or wording early so the print proof is ready
Hold December and late June dates as soon as they are fixed

faqs.q: Where do you unload for a hall on a residential street in Croydon?
faqs.a: We pull up as close to the entrance as the road allows, unload onto trolleys and wheel the kit straight in, then move the van to a legal parking space nearby. Hotels and banqueting suites usually have a car park or service yard, which makes the process even quicker.

faqs.q: Our function room is on the first floor. Will that be a problem?
faqs.a: Not for the LCD SlimPod, GIF Booth, Retro Pod or Selfie Mirror Pod, which our team carries up stairs regularly. The Magic Mirror, Party Booth and Inflatable Booth need a lift or a ground-floor room, so mention the stairs when you enquire and we will recommend a booth that suits the space.

faqs.q: Is there a travel fee for Purley, Coulsdon or Sanderstead?
faqs.a: Delivery and setup are included across the borough, from Norbury down to Coulsdon. If any travel contribution ever applies to a far-flung venue it is shown on the quote up front, so you know the full cost before paying the deposit.

faqs.q: Will ULEZ charges be added to the quote?
faqs.a: No. The whole borough sits inside the Ultra Low Emission Zone, and we cover that ourselves. The price on your quote is the price you pay, with delivery, setup, pack-down and the attendant all included.

faqs.q: Can one booking cover a mehndi night and the wedding reception?
faqs.a: Yes. Many multi-day weddings book a booth for two or more events, and each can have its own print design and booth. Give us the dates, venues and timings for every part of the celebration and we will put them on a single quote.

faqs.q: How do guests who leave early get their photos?
faqs.a: Every session is sent as a digital copy by email, and guests can share straight to social media from the booth. After the event we can also pass the full set of images to the hosts, so nobody misses out.
